package.description: Securely overwrite sensitive files and cleanse free space.

en-US.description: Securely overwrite sensitive files and cleanse free space.
en-US.longDescription: SDelete is a command line utility that takes a number of options. In any given use, it allows you to delete one or more files and/or directories, or to cleanse the free space on a logical disk. SDelete accepts wild card characters as part of the directory or file specifier.
en-US.name: SDelete
